task: Move search_kb from its own Knowledge Base toolkit group into Codebase Tools in UI and API/SDK listings, updating tests and accepting a direct tool-invoke behaviour change.

key_reasoning.reason: Closest pattern is the in-place merge in _merge_code_toolkit, which covers the grouping change. It does not cover the direct-invoke path: search_kb on a CODE-context assistant moves from an explicit ValueError to _get_code_tools returning None and then a find_tool_by_invoke_request fall-through whose result is untraced, and no test exists. Stale persisted toolkit names and the tool search index add to the risk. Rollback is trivial, so the score stays at M.
Option B is chosen, but a conflicting earlier story artifact records the UI-only option. The fate of the KB_TOOLS branch and enum is open, and the codemie-docs repo is unchecked.
